ios.desc:
Make a game as fast as you can think of one. Blamo turns any idea into a playable game in seconds for free. Type what you want: "a raccoon stealing snacks," "sharks with frickin' laser beams" and moments later you're playing it. No engine, no code, no build. Share to the feed and let anyone play. Send it to your friends with a link. Anyone can play on any device, even without installing the app. No ads, no purchases - just vibes.

How it works:
- Describe it, play it. You type an idea, Blamo builds the game. It's instantly shareable. Seconds, not weeks.
- Remix anything. See a game you like? Change the character, raise the difficulty, change the style, make it weirder. Every game is a starting point.
- Instant play. Nothing to download or install. Games run the moment you tap them.
- A social feed. Like, comment, and follow. Fun games spread because people share them.
- Record your fun. Instant play-to-sharable-video, optionally include face-camera.

What your Blamos can do:
- Native phone stuff. Haptic vibrations, tap, swipe, and tilt.
- Music generation. Automatically include game sounds and music from your description.
- 2D and 3D art. Any style you can think of, it'll do it's best to make it. 
- AI inside the game. An LLM inside what you make: adaptive enemies, generated dialogue, levels that never repeat.
- Global leaderboards. Every game ships with a scoreboard. Be the best in the world at all the weirdest games.
- Voice. Text-to-speech built in. Narrators, talking characters, voice prompts.
- Mini apps. Stuff that isn't even a game. Parody apps. Meme games.

Think it. Play it. Share it. Remix it. BLAMO!

quotes.text:
Hey HN, my name is Sam. My buddy Danny and I (and our good friend Claude) have been making this fun app to make and share vibe games. You just describe whatever game pops into your deranged little mind, and BLAMO! there it is, playable on your phone in under 30 seconds.

Super Mario Breakout? BLAMO! https://www.blamo.ai/vibes/7350a500-09bb-4ed9-866d-001006f6f83e

Text Adventure PacMan? BLAMO! https://www.blamo.ai/vibes/781cdd12-bc00-4f1a-8c6c-9726e143f4c6

And not just games, they can be little digital toys, and you can use generative AI _inside_ your creations. So you could make a digital pet generator, or maybe a creepy AI Mother's Day Card maker: https://www.blamo.ai/s/wfVwd

Because we're nerds who love recursion we obviously had to go down the rabbit hole of making a vibe game maker inside of our vibe game maker (and then make a vibe game maker inside of _that_ vibe game maker): https://www.blamo.ai/vibes/aad0b712-6459-48f9-a4ae-639b138a134f

We think it's a fun way to try out ideas and to be spontaneously creative. For example, if you're like me, you've probably had the thought, "is it possible to turn your phone into a vibrator using haptics?" Blamo! https://www.blamo.ai/vibes/ae38f783-f57a-4439-9a10-2bb4c5f77984

Is it possible to get people to throw their phone off a bridge for a high score? Blamo! https://www.blamo.ai/vibes/e01f92cd-b170-4036-a665-da1bab8dd1d6
